failure_classification.note: Zero parse/empty/compile failures in logs; all generated candidates compiled on first attempt in this run (no reflection, no re-queue).

phase_timing.evolution_last_vs_first_growth_pct: ~30% slower in final quarter vs first quarter

evolution_workload_composition.note: Each embedding batch is a single batched /embeddings request (list input), not N separate requests.
